rules: zh = the short Chinese name of a code of a dimension that is no place (a fuel of siec, a sector of nrg_bal), the one a page prints, marked with its name row name:zh_names:<dim>:<code>; zh_full = its full name, kept for reference and printed nowhere.
dims lists the dimensions this file names codes of; a code of a listed dimension with no entry has no name, and a page that would print it stops, never printing the code or an English name.

Only names the project owner reviewed are listed (zh_source 'reviewed', with the review date); a name is never machine-translated into this file. basis says whether the name is the source's own term (official) or the project's translation of a code the source names otherwise (own translation), and source names the document it was checked against.
